function.name: submit_review
function.arguments: {"is_bug":true,"summary":"The analysis has a substantive modeling bug: `fit_predict` places `width` and `time` in the spline transformer but sets `n_smooth = min(2, train_x.shape[1])`; for the time-only baseline, its sole time feature is smooth as intended, but `X_aug` appends lag delta/direction/interaction as linear terms. More importantly, the reported bootstrap contrast resamples rows as blocks but preserves precomputed direction labels, not recomputing lagged deltas on each resampled trajectory; this does not estimate uncertainty for the stated matched growth/decline contrast. The 0.1 s blocks are also shorter than indicated residual dependence (ACF1=0.865), so intervals are not reliable. In addition, expanding-window `TimeSeriesSplit` tests only later periods, confounding validation with temporal regime change; the augmented model does not improve versus the baseline (slightly worse RMSE/MAE), and the contrast CI includes zero. Fix by recomputing direction from each bootstrap block/trajectory with boundary handling, selecting blocks based on residual autocorrelation, and reporting that current evidence does not support predictive memory."}
